display.purpose: Page-level h1/h2 titles only. Never body copy, labels, or buttons.

body.purpose: All working UI text: labels, tables, forms, buttons, nav.

mono.purpose: Numerals that must align in columns: clock, counts, dates.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow for stat tiles and content cards.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover/focus shadow, paired with a -2px translateY lift.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active/press feedback on all interactive buttons (active:scale-*).

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.value: 200ms ease-out on background-color, border-color, color, fill
motion.purpose: Briefly applied to <html> during a dark/light/brand theme switch so surfaces crossfade together instead of snapping.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The canonical solid-fill call-to-action button, repeated verbatim across nearly every screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1F6F5C; color: #fff; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: "Public Sans", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(36,41,31,.06); transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #30AB8E; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1F6F5C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Ghost-style navigation button used inside the primary-green sidebar, with an accent edge indicator for the active item.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); background: transparent; border: none; text-align: left; font-family: "Public Sans", sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item__indicator { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); height: 20px; width: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #966122; opacity: 0; } .ds-nav-item--active .ds-nav-item__indicator { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Compact raised-paper tile with a soft ambient shadow that lifts slightly on hover, used for dashboard/summary metrics.
components.css: .ds-card { min-width: 140px; background: #FFFEFB; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(36,41,31,.06), 0 1px 1px rgba(36,41,31,.04); transition: box-shadow 200ms, transform 200ms; font-family: "Public Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(36,41,31,.10), 0 1px 3px rgba(36,41,31,.06); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card__label { font-size: 12px; color: #6B7280; } .ds-card__value { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #111827; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Recessed-tone text field that brightens and gains a soft primary ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-family: "Public Sans", sans-serif; color: #111827; background: #F9FAFB; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 8px; outline: none; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input:focus { background: #fff; border-color: #1F6F5C; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(31,111,92,0.2); }

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Dependency-free hover/focus tooltip: a small dark pill above the trigger element.
components.css: .ds-tooltip-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-flex; } .ds-tooltip { pointer-events: none; position: absolute; bottom: 100%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); margin-bottom: 6px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 6px; background: #111827; color: #fff; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; opacity: 0; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-tooltip-wrap:hover .ds-tooltip, .ds-tooltip-wrap:focus-within .ds-tooltip { opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview: LIKHA-SIS reads as a well-kept official record book, not a SaaS dashboard: warm paper surfaces, an editorial serif for headings, and a deep institutional green that carries the same trust a school seal carries on a printed certificate. The mood is warm and official — approachable enough for daily use by teachers and coordinators, but never playful; every screen should feel like it belongs in the same binder as a report card or SF9 form. Density stays moderate: enough breathing room to scan a table of learners at a glance, without the whitespace of a marketing site. Each deploying school can recolor the system through its own logo, but the structure — warm paper base, serif display headings, confident solid-fill primary actions, soft-lift cards — is the fixed identity beneath every school's palette. Tingub National High School's teal-green is the reference/default instance of that identity, not a hardcoded constant. Elevation and shadow treatment is not yet locked as an invariant — the current soft-shadow-on-cards-only pattern is a reasonable default but open to a bolder pass.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper base (never pure white or cool gray) with a deep green institutional accent
Serif display headings (Fraunces) paired with a clean grotesque body face (Public Sans)
Confident, solid-fill buttons with tactile press feedback (active:scale-[0.97-0.99])
Per-school brand recoloring underneath a fixed structural identity
Strict print/screen separation: printed DepEd forms always render in the light-mode palette regardless of on-screen theme

rules.name: The Paper, Not Glass Rule
rules.body: Every neutral surface token is warm and slightly desaturated — never a cool gray, never pure white, never a translucent/glass effect on a base surface. Paper (light) and near-black-green paper (dark) are the two allowed grounds.

rules.name: The Print-Light Rule
rules.body: Printable documents force --color-* back to the light-mode values under @media print, regardless of the active on-screen theme. A printed page must never carry the brighter dark-mode brand variant onto paper.

rules.name: The One-School, One-Palette Rule
rules.body: --lm-*/--dm-* are derived per-school from an uploaded logo, contrast-checked to WCAG AA. Never hardcode a hex brand color into a component; always consume it through the --color-* / Tailwind primary/accent/leaf tokens.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Fraunces appears only on page-level h1/h2 titles (font-display). Every other piece of type stays in Public Sans.

dos: Do consume brand color exclusively through the --color-* custom properties / Tailwind primary/accent/leaf classes, never a hardcoded hex.
Do reuse the exact primary-button recipe (bg-primary text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold shadow-sm active:scale-[0.97-0.99]) for new primary actions.
Do keep font-display (Fraunces) reserved for page-level h1/h2 titles only.
Do force printable components back to the light-mode brand variables under @media print, independent of the on-screen theme.
donts: Don't use cool grays or pure white as a base surface — Warm Paper / Raised Paper are the only grounds.
Don't apply the serif display font to body text, table data, labels, or buttons.
Don't let dark-mode or brand-theme styling leak into printed output.
Don't treat the current flat-plus-card-shadow elevation model as fixed doctrine — it's confirmed as the present baseline only, open to revision in a future bolder/polish pass.
